title: Circular Measure Module 6 Lesson 2: Symbolic Form & Unassigned Parameters custom practice

parts.prompt: A circular sector has radius $r$ and central angle $\theta$ radians. Express its complete perimeter in terms of $r$ and $\theta$ in factored form.
A circular sector of radius $r$ has arc length $s$ and area $A$. Eliminate $\theta$ to express $A$ in terms of $r$ and $s$.
A chord in a circle of radius $r$ subtends an angle $2\theta$ at the centre, where $0 < \theta < \pi/2$. Express the length of the chord in terms of $r$ and $\theta$.

A chord in a circle of radius $r$ subtends a central angle of $2\theta$ radians, where $0 < \theta < \pi/2$. Express the area of the minor segment cut off by the chord in terms of $r$ and $\theta$, simplifying using the double-angle identity $\sin(2\theta) = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

Two tangents from an external point $T$ touch a circle of radius $r$ at $A$ and $B$. Given that $\angle AOB = 2\theta$ where $0 < \theta < \pi/2$, express the total area of the kite $OATB$ in terms of $r$ and $\theta$.
An annular sector has inner radius $r$, outer radius $kr$ ($k > 1$), and central angle $\theta$ radians. Express its area in terms of $r, k$ and $\theta$ in factored form.
An annular sector has inner radius $r$, outer radius $2r$ and area $A$, where $r>0$ and $0<A<3\pi r^2$. Express its complete perimeter in terms of $r$ and $A$ only.
